req.title: List cookies
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /cookies with a JSON body listing all cookies present on the request.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should return a JSON body listing all cookies present on the request when a GET request is made to the /cookies endpoint. The test suite includes a positive test to verify correct behavior, a negative test to handle unexpected input, and a boundary test to check edge cases.

tests.name: test_list_cookies_positive
preconditions: The server is running and accessible.
actions: Set a cookie using the /cookies/set endpoint.
Send a GET request to the /cookies endpoint.
expected: The response JSON contains the set cookie.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()

# Set a cookie
client.get('/cookies/set/testcookie/testvalue')

# Get cookies
response = client.get('/cookies')

assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.json == {'cookies': {'testcookie': 'testvalue'}}

tests.name: test_list_cookies_negative
preconditions: The server is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to the /cookies endpoint with an invalid method.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()

# Attempt to use an invalid method (POST) on the /cookies endpoint
response = client.post('/cookies')

assert response.status_code == 405

tests.name: test_list_cookies_boundary
preconditions: The server is running and accessible.
actions: Set a large number of cookies using the /cookies/set endpoint.
Send a GET request to the /cookies endpoint.
expected: The response JSON contains all set cookies.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()

# Set a large number of cookies
for i in range(1, 101):
    client.get(f'/cookies/set/cookie{i}/value{i}')

# Get cookies
response = client.get('/cookies')

assert response.status_code == 200
assert len(response.json['cookies']) == 100
